commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Mallorca take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
88' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
86' 5:18 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
84' Gustavo Siviero has decided to substitute Samu Costa and he is replaced by Javier Llabres (Mallorca).
84' It is time for a substitution. Abdon Prats (Mallorca) is on for Jan Virgili.
84' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to make a change. Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) replaces Mikel Oyarzabal.
84' That will be all from Jon Gorrotxategi who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Yangel Herrera (Real Sociedad).
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Miguel Sesma didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
79' Gustavo Siviero decides to make a substitution. Pablo Maffeo will be replaced by Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca).
79' Omar Mascarell will be replaced by Manu Morlanes (Mallorca).
78' Miguel Sesma blows his whistle and it's Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
76' A lofted pass into the box is met by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), who rifles a shot just over the bar.
74' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
71' Mallorca hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
69' Gustavo Siviero prepares a substitution. Mateo Joseph is replaced by Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca).
69' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
68' The ball goes out of play. Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
67' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Sesma had an easy-decision to make.
65' The total number of attempts is 4:9.
63' Today's match ends for Arsen Zakharyan who will be replaced by Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad).
63' Here is a change. Carlos Soler is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad).
62' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Real Sociedad.
61' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad).
61' The game is interrupted. Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
60' Real Sociedad get a corner.
59' Samu Costa (Mallorca) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
58' A player from Real Sociedad commits a rough challenge. Miguel Sesma blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
56' Real Sociedad work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
54' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 45:55.
52' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) makes a rough challenge and Miguel Sesma blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
48' Some great controlled play and passing from Real Sociedad. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' It will be a corner kick for Real Sociedad.

43' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad win a corner kick.
42' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
40' Miguel Sesma has a clear sight and sees a foul from Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad).
38' Corner kicks – 1:3.
36' 0 - 1 Goal! Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 0:1.
35' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
33' The foul by Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) was seen by Miguel Sesma who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
32' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) runs onto a pass and thumps the ball goalward from distance, but the keeper doesn't have to move as it goes well wide of the right post.
31' Half-chance! Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) plays a pass into the box, but Leo Roman reacts well to snuff out the attack.
28' 1:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
26' Real Sociedad hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
24' Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Miguel Sesma signals.
22' This shall not pass! Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
21' Miguel Sesma blows his whistle. Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) commits a foul after dangerous play.
20' Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
19' Real Sociedad take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
19' The linesman makes the right call and Real Sociedad will have a corner.
18' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) plays a through ball but overhits it.
16' The percentage of ball possession is – 41:59.
14' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
12' Real Sociedad are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
10' Mallorca are ruled offside.
9' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

8' It looks like Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) saw red with that tackle. Miguel Sesma won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Mallorca win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
7' Miguel Sesma interrupts the game. One of the players from Real Sociedad won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
6' Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
4' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
3' Some patient build-up play from Mallorca as they look to unlock the defence.
1' The first half has just begun.
